about: The NekoTrail palette, Moonlight: the one place brand colours live. Edit here, then run `bun scripts/brand.ts`. It redraws every logo, icon and card and rewrites site/src/styles/tokens.css. `colors` are the named swatches, `themes` the dark and light UI tokens (every text pair passes WCAG AA), `icon` the app icon.

colors.name: Moonlight
colors.use: The one brand colour. Primary buttons and focus on dark, the hero emphasis, the app icon glow.

colors.name: Indigo
colors.use: Primary fill on light, cat stripes, outline and tail.

colors.name: Indigo Text
colors.use: Brand text on light backgrounds.

colors.name: Moonlight Text
colors.use: Brand text on dark backgrounds and the sky.

colors.name: Lantern
colors.use: The single warm attention colour: Needs you, unread, the cat's commit-stars, the icon star.

colors.name: Lantern Deep
colors.use: Lantern fills on light backgrounds, and the wordmark star on light.

colors.name: Lantern Ink
colors.use: Lantern text on light backgrounds.

colors.name: Night
colors.use: App canvas on dark, and the wordmark on light backgrounds.

colors.name: Dusk
colors.use: The glow at the bottom of the night sky.

colors.name: Midnight
colors.use: The top of the night sky, deepest backdrop.

colors.name: Starlight
colors.use: Lit stars and text on the sky.

colors.name: Paper
colors.use: Light backgrounds, the wordmark on dark.

colors.name: Mist
colors.use: Light surfaces and the light sidebar.

colors.name: Silver
colors.use: The cat's fur and the icon mark. Mascot only.

colors.name: Stripe
colors.use: Tabby stripes, outline, whiskers and tail. Mascot only.

colors.name: Cat Ink
colors.use: The cat's eyes and mouth (dark eyes on a light face, so cursor-follow reads). Mascot only.

colors.name: Glint
colors.use: Eye highlight; moves with the pupil. Mascot only.

colors.name: Blush
colors.use: Inner ears and cheeks, the one warm note on the face. Mascot only.

colors.name: Nose
colors.use: The cat's nose. Mascot only.

colors.name: Paw
colors.use: Paws. Mascot only.

colors.name: Commit Star
colors.use: The commit dots on the merge tail (lantern). Mascot only.
